title: Closeout summary: Stable doctor and gate verdict shape under result truncation
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented stable doctor and gate closeout verdict fields under result truncation. Doctor results now expose blockingDiagnosticCodes, gate closeout exposes top-level fixed and blockingDiagnosticCodes plus nested doctor blocking codes, and spooled doctor/gate results copy ok/fixed/blockingDiagnosticCodes to the same data paths as inline results. Verification passed; git checkpoint could not be completed because .git/index.lock writes were denied while staging mixed-file hunks.

Close reason: implemented and verified; commit checkpoint blocked by sandbox git index lock
